description_prefix: arguments beyond the declared parameters of `mk_print`
why: The tail actual is the borrowed formal `path`. untracked_bases() admits it as data only when every call it reaches is declared: `stat(path, ...)` is declared by W43-LIBC-RESTRICT-PROTOTYPES (in PREV, not on the card branch) and `open(path, ...)` by this card (not in PREV); both take it borrowed. Only the combined tree declares both, so the four mk_err(..., path) tail refusals are admitted. The function stays Unknown.
